Name: Lnh's YuanHuan Farm
Author: liunianhui
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]新农场又来了，默认替换标准农场。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]农舍位于地图中心，被一个圆形河流包裹。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]农场内设有多个矿车，交通便利。 [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]The new farm is here again, replacing the standard farm by default. [/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]The farmhouse is located in the center of the map, surrounded by a circular river.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]There are multiple mine carts on the farm with convenient transportation.[/color][/size][/center]
